features.name: Credential Manager: "Both" checkbox to create users in the workspace and a portal
features.description: Feature Properties → Use as Credential Manager → "Create users in" has a new "Both"; checkbox on the right. When checked, Workspace and Portal are both selected, a portal must be; picked, and every record creates a workspace user and a portal user. The mapping list shows; separate "Workspace Roles" and "Portal Roles" fields (plus Portal Category), and there are two; default-role lists: Default Workspace Role(s) and Default Portal Role(s). Checking or unchecking; "Both" clears the role mappings and default roles, because their meaning changes. Portal sign-up; settings list "Both" features for their portal.
features.impact: The same user sometimes needs to be created in both places at once, with different roles.

enhancements.description: The Settings → **Row actions** section is removed, along with everything it set: show or hide Add / Edit / Delete, Add position, new row at top, ask before deleting, Save each row / Save with, the table's words and colours, and button looks. The definition table again has its fixed "+ Add definition" (runtime only, not drawn on the builder canvas), pencil, bin and words, as before 2026-11-10. **Kept:** a record opened in **View** shows no Add, Edit or Delete (before 2026-11-10 they still worked there).
enhancements.benefit: Add, Edit and Delete already existed. The extra settings were not needed: of 318 definition tables on the UAT host, none had any of them saved, and the address page saves with the page's own Save button.

enhancements.description: Table → Settings → **Add Button** (Definition tables only): Button text, Button colour, Text colour. Empty keeps "Add definition", the brand colour and white text. The Settings panel now reads the table type the same way the table does (`resolveTableKind`), so sections shown only for a table type also appear when the type is saved only under `table.source.tableType`. An empty colour in a seeded colour field shows "Default" instead of "#000000".
enhancements.benefit: The button's words and colours were fixed.

knownIssues: Because some menu structures have changed, certain features may return a 403 status code. To resolve this, edit the role, select the platform feature, and save the role again.
Use the conventional feature-wise approach wherever workflow scheduling is required.
